rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a receipt or written proof that money or goods were received.

example.english: I'll keep the receipt for now.
example.jyutping: ngo5 lau4 dai1 zoeng1 sau1 geoi3 sin1

rows.note: Use this casually in a shop for the transaction slip, though it can also mean the bill or order rather than specifically proof of payment.

example.jyutping: m4 goi1 bei2 zoeng1 daan1 ngo5
